optimus.describe: A very deep, powerful, resonant male voice of a giant heroic robot leader, speaking Russian with a native Russian accent. Slow, commanding, noble and solemn delivery like an epic movie trailer narrator, with a subtle metallic resonance. Very low pitch, bass-heavy, perfect studio audio quality.
optimus.sample: Бит, под который удобно думать, что ты... Оптимус Прайм. Автоботы, по машинам! Эта планета под нашей защитой.

surovyy.describe: An extremely deep, gravelly, rough male voice of a huge menacing monster warrior, speaking Russian with a native Russian accent. Growling and raspy, theatrical and comically over-serious, slow and heavy delivery. Very low pitch, perfect studio audio quality.
surovyy.sample: Бит, под который удобно думать, что ты... Оптимус Прайм. Автоботы, по машинам! Эта планета под нашей защитой.
